rules.description: Voyager only: Command+arrows focuses OmniWM columns, stacked windows or adjacent workspaces
Built-in smart Caps (Caps to Right Control in Simple Modifications): app shortcuts and focus
Built-in Caps/Control+Shift: move whole columns horizontally or one window vertically across workspace edges
Voyager only: Shift+Command+arrows moves whole columns horizontally or one window vertically across workspace edges
Built-in Caps+Option+O opens OmniWM overview; Caps+Space opens the launcher
Voyager only: Command+O opens OmniWM overview; Command+Space remains the native launcher
Built-in Caps+Command: J/Down cycles next monitor, K/Up cycles previous; add Shift+direction to send one window
Voyager only: Control+Command+Down/Up cycles next/previous monitor; add Shift+arrows to send one window
Built-in Caps+Option+Enter maximizes the column; add Shift for OmniWM fullscreen
Voyager only: Command+Option+Enter maximizes the column; add Shift for OmniWM fullscreen
Built-in Caps+Option+R cycles column widths; Caps+Option+F fills available width
Voyager only: Command+Option+R cycles column widths
Built-in Caps+Command+Minus/Equal resizes column width; add Shift for window height
Voyager only: Control+Command+Minus/Equal resizes column width; add Shift for window height
Built-in smart Caps: GUI undo/redo, cut, select all, find and new; browser tabs/reload only in Zen, Chrome, Firefox and Safari; Caps+K stays WM focus
Voyager only: either Control sends GUI Command app shortcuts including cut, browser tabs/reload in Zen/Chrome/Firefox/Safari, and paste everywhere
Voyager pointer only: left Control+left-click sends Command+left-click in browsers and named terminal hosts
